messages:
Elio Fernandez: hi everyone! excited to be here. quick setup q: who handles monitor arms and adapters? i'm bringing a personal usb-c dock. also curious about keyboard preferences (i'm a tactile switch person). fun icebreaker: two truths + a lie: i climbed kilimanjaro, i grew up in seoul, i'm allergic to shellfish. also any tip for first-week pairing buddies?

Jon (IT Support): welcome Elio! we handle monitors and adapters. drop your machine model and preferred stand type and i'll add it to the pickup. most folks go for horizontal arms + VESA. if you need a USB-C dongle, we have spare.

Maya (People Ops): congrats! for pairing buddies we usually assign a mentor from your team and a buddy from another team. i'll loop in your manager after this thread and set up intro calendar invites. dietary prefs? we do a welcome lunch on Friday.

Elio Fernandez: thanks! no shellfish bc allergies (that's one truth). vegetarian ok for lunch. my machine: MacBook Pro 16 (M1 Pro).

Jon (IT Support): got it. to enroll your mac for MDM, run:
```
redwood-it enroll --os macos --serial SNR-8392
```
and paste the output here. i'll provision a loaner monitor if pickup timing doesn't match.

Ravi K.: two truths/lie guess: Kilimanjaro is the lie? :mountain:

Kara L.: welcome Elio! i'm on eng-platform. happy to be your buddy if you want. coffee status: must be medium roast. :coffee:

Elio Fernandez: haha kilimanjaro is real — i did it during a gap year. grew up in seoul is the lie. thanks @Kara, would love a buddy.

Devex Bot: Welcome package created for elio.fernandez — docs: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/elio. Tasks: badge pickup, security training, repo access request. Estimated completion: 3 business days.

Maya (People Ops): parking note: short-term guest parking needs a permit from Facilities, long-term staff parking sign-up is via the intranet. i'll DM you the form.

Jon (IT Support): once you paste the enroll output i'll push the image and invite you to the device pickup slot (tomorrow 10:30am or 2pm).

Elio Fernandez: pasted the enroll output to dm, thanks! appreciate the warm welcome everyone, looking forward to pairing and snagging a sticker pack. :sparkles:
